name: TeamStarWolf - The Cuckoo's Egg Intrusion (LBL, 1986) Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Retrospective ATT&CK v20.0 mapping of the 1986 to 1987 intrusion at Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory as described in Clifford Stoll, 'Stalking the Wily Hacker', Communications of the ACM 31(5), May 1988. Revoked T1562 behavior is shown under its v20.0 successor T1685 per data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CUCKOOS_EGG_1986.md. Scores: 100 is behavior the paper describes directly, 40 is an Inferred mapping.
